note: Per-manager storylines for COMPLETED seasons. Keyed by season -> stable Sleeper ownerId. Static archive (past results never change); the history page joins these to history.json standings for author/finish/record. Regenerate/extend with scripts/generate-season-stories.mjs.

1132933728533270528.headline: The Alaskan Bull Worm 🏔️🪱 bullied the whole league for 14 weeks — then vanished the second a ring was on the line.
1132933728533270528.detail: A league-best 10-4 and the top seed in 2025, and it was THICKS lifting the trophy. All that regular-season muscle, zero hardware.

1134715278987943936.headline: One Nut Barner put together a 9-5 season and still came up a nut short of the title.
1134715278987943936.detail: Second in the standings with 1737 points for, but the ring went elsewhere. Respectable — and totally forgettable.

784624291579854848.headline: THICKS snuck in as the 3-seed and walked out with the entire thing — your 2025 champion.
784624291579854848.detail: Just 1643 points for, the fewest of any contender, but he peaked when it mattered and took the ring. Ugly? Sure. Champions don't apologize.

1116599370310356992.headline: The African Bald Fraud led the ENTIRE league in scoring and somehow couldn't crack the top three.
1116599370310356992.detail: A league-high 1860 points for in 2025 and a 4th-place finish to show for it. All that offense, all that hairline, no ring. Fraudulent.

1132905719180943360.headline: The Ultimate Light Skin finished dead even at 7-7 — the living definition of 'fine, I guess.'
1132905719180943360.detail: 1756 points for and a fifth-place finish. Nobody feared him, nobody pitied him. He was just... there.

1132877923033391104.headline: Bubble Guts churned out another flavorless 7-7 in 2025.
1132877923033391104.detail: Sixth place, 1686 points for, no pulse in the playoff race. That all-time points record he owns felt like a lifetime ago.

1265145602090483712.headline: The Mexican Bald Fraud went a lukewarm 7-7 — proof the Bald Fraud disease crosses borders.
1265145602090483712.detail: Seventh at 1581 points for, the lowest of the entire .500 pack. Him and MJ should start a support group.

474461892971065344.headline: The Milk Man defended his crown by, uh, missing the playoffs entirely at 6-8.
474461892971065344.detail: The reigning 2024 champ curdled to eighth with just 1563 points for. From ring to wreck in one season — Megamind outsmarted only himself.

1264710608129884160.headline: Our resident DPRK defector defected from contention by midseason, sliding to 6-8 and ninth.
1264710608129884160.detail: 1549 points for and buried in the standings before the leaves turned. The Supreme Leader would not be pleased.

1265163251033849856.headline: Auntie Thomas cooked up a cold 6-8 and a tenth-place finish in 2025.
1265163251033849856.detail: 1509 points for, third-worst in the league. The easy way and the hard way both led straight to the lottery.

1265186290593189888.headline: The Prince of Persia ruled over nothing but the basement at 5-9.
1265186290593189888.detail: 1464 points for and eleventh place. A prince with no throne, no playoffs, and no answers.

1265060864969424896.headline: Chauncey face-planted to dead last at 4-10 — worst offense AND most points allowed in the whole league.
1265060864969424896.detail: A league-low 1430 points for against a league-worst 1696 against. 'Talented tenth'? More like the talented last.

1134715278987943936.headline: One Nut Barner bulldozed 2024 to an 11-3 record — still the most wins this league has EVER seen — and got nothing for it.
1134715278987943936.detail: 2100 points for and the top seed, and the ring still slipped away. The greatest regular season in Busters history, trophy case empty.

1132877923033391104.headline: Bubble Guts dropped a franchise-record 2201 points in 2024 — and finished second with nothing to hug at night.
1132877923033391104.detail: The most points anyone has ever scored in a Busters season, wasted on an 8-6 finish. All-you-can-eat, still went home hungry.

474461892971065344.headline: The Milk Man snuck in at 7-7 and delivered the 2024 title right to his own doorstep.
474461892971065344.detail: Just a .500 regular season and third in points among the contenders, but Megamind's big head made the biggest plays when it counted. Ring earned.

1116599370310356992.headline: The African Bald Fraud's origin story: a thoroughly average 7-7 way back in 2024.
1116599370310356992.detail: 1988 points for and a fourth-place finish. The fraud was already in full bloom — we just didn't have the name for it yet.

1127784442816344064.headline: Triciagloston scrapped to a 6-7-1 in 2024 before exiting the league — a Buster we hardly knew.
1127784442816344064.detail: 2094 points for and a fifth-place finish, then off into the sunset. The seat was needed for fresher slander.

1132905719180943360.headline: The Ultimate Light Skin tied his way to a 6-7-1, sixth-place snooze in 2024.
1132905719180943360.detail: 2047 points for and stuck square in the muddled middle. Even the ties couldn't break the monotony.

1132933728533270528.headline: The Alaskan Bull Worm 🏔️🪱 scored the third-most points in 2024 and STILL got buried at 5-9.
1132933728533270528.detail: 2139 points for — but a league-worst 2262 against. The worm got stepped on nearly every week. Genuinely, cosmically unlucky.

784624291579854848.headline: Before the ring, THICKS — back when he was 'Sticks' — bottomed out in dead last in 2024 at 5-9.
784624291579854848.detail: A league-low 1767 points for and the cellar all to himself. One year later he'd be the champ. Never forget the basement, Thicks.
